profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: SDE Intern
positions.description: Maintained and improved internal tools for AWS EC2 Recovery Systems team.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintained and implemented features for an internal issue tracking system.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a Ruby developer to collaboratively build an account management system for an online commerce game store.

Developed backend web services and components to integrate with third-party services for tax calculation and payment processing.

Developed various features of the system and provided assistance and documentation for them.

Refactored and cleaned up legacy code to improve overall system structure.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked with a senior developer to build an internal tool utilizing C# and ASP.NET to speed up developer productivity rating process.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Worked as a main Ruby on Rails developer under the guidance of Prof. Tomlinson to collaboratively build a website that helps explore environmental causality. The website aims to be an online tool to let users jointly construct and contribute to a causal map which ultimately represents complex relationships among environmental issues.

Developed, as part of the tool, a reputation management system to reward users for their contributions and a history revision system to control and revert undesirable changes to the causal map.

Collaboratively developed a simple interface for a causal map graphing game to record user understanding about environmental relationships and built scripts to later reconstruct the graphs for further research.

Was awarded the Outstanding Undergraduate Researcher Award by Prof. Tomlinson for my contributions.

positions.title: Math Tutor
positions.description: Tutored and helped high school students understand algebra, geometry, and precalculus concepts and be able solve homework problems.

positions.title: Math Tutor
positions.description: Tutored and helped college students understand algebra, geometry, precalculus, and calculus concepts and be able to solve homework problems.
